messages:
Maeve: Quick sync — microlaunch plan for next Wed. We want a short webinar + 48hr starter credit drip + prompt-template pack in the welcome flow. Goal: move new signups to 1+ meaningful request within 72h.
Ravi: Love it. Confirming webinar CTA sends to landing with auto-credit claiming?
Maeve: Yes — landing collects email + small intent checkbox. After submit: immediate 100 credits applied, show one-click prompt pack download.
Jordan: For the prompt pack: can we bake in 3 templates: code assistant, PR summary, and customer email generator? Lightweight docs + examples.
Anika: I can own prompt pack content. ETA Tue EOD for draft.
Kai: Routing question — inbound leads from the webinar form: route to sales only if they tick "enterprise" and >5 employees, otherwise self-serve journey. Ops can tag with "webinar-seed".
Ben: For the 48hr drip, propose: 0h = claim credits (in-app banner + email), 24h = short tutorial + 3 templates, 48h = activation nudge with in-app sample prompt and CTA to try one request. A/B test subject lines and in-app phrasing.
Lena: How do we measure the "meaningful request"? We should define it: >= 50 tokens && uses a template or tool call.
Maeve: Agree. Metric = first_request_count where tokens >=50 OR template_used=true. We'll capture via event 'first_activation'.
Ravi: Implementation note — onboarding flow needs to attach credits to user profile and expire after 14d. Also add a flag to prevent double-crediting if they already used promo.
Jordan: Marketing assets: social launch post, short demo clip (45s), and webinar RSVP on homepage. I can draft copy.
Anika: For the email sequences, I'll share copy variants A and B by Tue. One leans product-first, one leans outcome-first.
Kai: ops-bot: please create inbound tag and routing rule: "webinar-seed" -> if enterprise checkbox true AND company_size>=6 -> sales-queue, else -> self-serve.
ops-bot: Created rule #1432: tag=webinar-seed, sales-queue predicate=company_size>=6 AND enterprise=true, else self-serve. Logs: https://internal.ops/rules/1432
Ben: A/B test matrix: subject lines, in-app banner copy, email CTAs. We'll track conversion at claim, first_request, and 7d retention.
Lena: I'll add the analytics dashboard tile (cohort: webinar-registrants) and pin conversion steps.
Ravi: One concern: fraud/abuse on free credits. Suggest rate-limit claim to 1 account per ip/day and basic heuristics. Security signoff needed.
Maeve: Noted. @Ravi, please loop in security for the rule; we should ship with throttling.
Ravi: Looping @ops-bot and @Lena to show required flags.
Anika: Timeline check — webinar Tue 10am PT, landing + credit claim must be live Mon 5pm PT for QA.
Jordan: Creative deadlines: social + clip by Mon 12pm PT to schedule.
Kai: I'll validate routing rules and smoke test on Tue morning.
Ben: Measurement plan: cohort-level funnel, lift vs baseline cohort (last month organic signups), lift target = +12% activation within 7d.
Maeve: Owners: Landing + credits = Ravi, Prompt pack = Anika, Creative + posts = Jordan, Drip emails = Ben, Analytics = Lena, Routing = Kai.
Ravi: I'll create the feature branch and drop the claim button code snippet here: ```js
// claim credits
fetch('/api/credits/claim', {method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({promo: 'WEB-MICRO'} )})
```
Lena: Quick note: include UTM params on landing links so we can attribute webinar vs social.
Jordan: Will do. Also proposing a short benchmark narrative for the webinar slide deck: "How teams cut LLM cost per useful response by 30% with caching + batching" — ties to our Optimize offering.
Maeve: Good hook. Keep it product-agnostic but with a clear case study blurb.
Anika: I'll draft a 1-paragraph case study to insert.
Kai: Anything blocking security review? Ravi?
Ravi: Requesting security review, will ping @security in the morning. Throttling + fraud rules included.
Maeve: Great. Can everyone drop final assets in the #marketing-drive folder by Mon 1pm PT? We want a full runbook for on-call on Tues.
Ben: I'll assemble the runbook and include rollback steps if credit service spikes.
Jordan: Social copy preview (short): "Join our 30-min microlaunch: ship LLM features faster — free credits for attendees + starter prompt pack. Wed 10am PT. RSVP -> claim credits."
Maeve: Love it. Last ask: please add the experiment tag in amplitude as 'exp/webinar-seed-2025' so we can slice.
Lena: Done — amplitude experiment id: exp_2025_webinar_seed.
Maeve: Perfect. Locking on plan. Thank you everyone :thumbsup:
Kai: 👍 I'll schedule a smoke run Wed 7am PT.
Ben: See you at dry run Mon 4pm PT.
Anika: I'll have email variants ready.
Jordan: Creative in-drive.
Ravi: Feature branch opened, will request review.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run reminder Mon 3:45pm PT -> #marketing and #eng-oncall.
